description: This Java source file defines the class SagePayServices, which provides methods to interface with the SagePay payment gateway. It includes functionalities for payment authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund, constructing HTTP requests, parsing responses, and handling errors. The class also contains a private method to build configuration properties based on the context and database entities.

classes.name: SagePayServices
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to perform various payment operations through SagePay, including authentication, authorization, release, voiding, and refund. It constructs necessary HTTP requests, processes responses, manages configuration properties, and logs actions and errors.

methods.name: buildSagePayProperties
methods.description: Builds a map of configuration properties for SagePay from the database based on the provided context and delegator.

methods.name: paymentAuthentication
methods.description: Handles the payment authentication process by constructing request parameters, sending HTTP POST to SagePay, and processing the response to return status and details.

methods.name: paymentAuthorisation
methods.description: Performs payment authorization by preparing request data, communicating with SagePay, and interpreting the response for success or failure.

methods.name: paymentRelease
methods.description: Releases a previously authorized payment, handling the request and response flow with SagePay.

methods.name: paymentVoid
methods.description: Voids a payment, sending the request to SagePay and processing the response.

methods.name: paymentRefund
methods.description: Processes refunds through SagePay by sending the appropriate request and handling the response.
